protocol.reason: Round 1 final 45/65 external, baby 11/20, worse than v1; not accepted for release. Its 16k->8k linear downsampling aliased high frequencies. Correct augmentation uses anti-aliasing before 8k reduction; fixed 80 epochs avoid early-epoch refit instability.
protocol.selection: Five official outer folds; next fold cyclically validates inner models trained on other three folds. Select config per outer using inner utility only; retrain selected config on four folds. Final config by mean inner utility, fit all 390.
protocol.utility: 0.4*(clean macro recall + phone macro recall) + 0.1*(clean baby recall + phone baby recall); equal clean and synthetic-phone inner validation
protocol.augmentation: Only clean / anti-aliased 8k phone view, 50/50; no clipping, masking, gain or Gaussian feature noise
protocol.phone_view: scipy.signal.resample_poly(...,1,2,window=(kaiser,5.0)); clip/round to PCM16 8k; original v11 linear 8k->16k conversion
protocol.lowband: First 19 original v11 mel filters, nonzero support ends at 3781.25 Hz; discard unavailable >4k phone information
protocol.seeds: Inner 1000+fold, outer 2000+fold, final4242; one seed per fit, no external seed hunting
protocol.optimizer: AdamW .002, wd .005, cosine80 to .00005, label smoothing .05, inverse sqrt class weights, dropout .15, batch32
protocol.external_role: Previously seen development-validation; not untouched final test

selection.config_selection_basis: Round2 equal clean/synthetic-phone inner utility only, fixed80, no external score/seed selection
